description: This Java class 'SagePayUtil' provides utility methods for constructing payment response maps, building HTTP requests, and parsing HTTP responses for SagePay payment processing integration within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SagePayUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for handling SagePay payment responses, HTTP request construction, and response parsing.

methods.name: buildCardAuthorisationPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map representing the response for card authorization, including optional fields.

methods.name: buildCardCapturePaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map representing the response for card capture, including optional fields.

methods.name: buildCardReleasePaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map representing the response for card release, including optional fields.

methods.name: buildCardVoidPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map representing the response for card void, including optional fields.

methods.name: buildCardRefundPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map representing the response for card refund, including optional fields.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Creates an HttpHost object based on SagePay properties, selecting production or testing host.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Creates an HttpHost object given host name, port, and scheme.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Parses HttpResponse to extract key-value pairs from response data.

methods.name: getHttpPost
methods.description: Builds an HttpPost object with given URI and parameters, including headers.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a default CloseableHttpClient instance.
